blueprint.context: The crossing arrives inside Master Sarn's joint tile with Vask's letter to the keeper of the roll travelling in the same mail bag.
objectives: Use the tally-stick as evidence and have it refused where it would matter
Let Denet obey the College house rule at last, four hours before it stops being worth anything
Get the depth, the quality and the volume all onto a public roll
Show that a complete record moves nothing while the ground is sealed

setting.description: Tallow Reach: the red shelf and the outbound weighbridge under the salt wall, and the Level House three streets up - cut stone, lead roof, a datum scribed in the floor and a meridian slit in the north wall.

synopsis: Tallow Reach, the forty-fifth day. The weighbridge takes the tally-stick as a book of account, enters the ballast and the debt, and will not enter the water; Ysoly makes the clerk write that she asked. Three streets up at the Level House, Denet finally makes the four-line entry, and a fifth, copying the volume off a caravan master's notches. Six hours later the depot bag brings Vask's six lines and the College lifts his seal. The record is complete, correct, public - and changes nothing, because the ground is held and the Wardenry appoints the surveyor.
title: The Far Rim
